note: Stevens County KS zones its unincorporated land (zoning regulations PDF lists AG, RR, SR, R-1, V-1, AO districts), but publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its GIS page lists only PDF maps (City of Hugoton, City of Moscow, taxing and commissioner districts). Hugoton city code says the official zoning map is kept by the city clerk. ArcGIS searches for Stevens County KS, Hugoton, Moscow and Johnson City KS found no zoning service; the Stevens County Hub zoning layers belong to Minnesota and Johnson City TN.
